title: Step 5a: Visualizing K-Means Clusters of Customer Data with Python Scatter

cues.en: Instructor: All right, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 講師：好，開始吧。

cues.en: Let's start by creating a new code cell.
cues.zh: 先建立一個新的程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: And the way we're gonna do this will be by doing several scatter plots for each of the clusters.
cues.zh: 我們會為每個群組分別畫散布圖。

cues.en: So we'll actually scatter plot cluster one, then we will scatter plot cluster two, up to cluster five.
cues.zh: 也就是先畫第一群，再畫第二群，一直到第五群。

cues.en: All right, so you know how to scatter plot.
cues.zh: 你已經知道怎麼畫散布圖。

cues.en: There is this function which we actually used before in both regression and classification.
cues.zh: 之前做迴歸與分類時，都用過這個函式。

cues.en: That function is of course scatter.
cues.zh: 它當然就是 scatter。

cues.en: And this function belongs to the matplotlib.pyplot module.
cues.zh: 這個函式屬於 matplotlib.pyplot 模組。

cues.en: And therefore, we're gonna call our shortcut here plt from which we'll call indeed this scatter function.
cues.zh: 因此先呼叫簡稱 plt，再從中呼叫 scatter 函式。

cues.en: All right, so remember, what do we have to input inside this scatter function?
cues.zh: 記得 scatter 函式裡要輸入什麼嗎？

cues.en: Well, actually everything is here.
cues.zh: 其實這裡都有。

cues.en: First, we have to input the x-coordinates of the points, then the y-coordinates of the points.
cues.zh: 首先輸入各點的 X 座標，再輸入 Y 座標。

cues.en: Then that's the size.
cues.zh: 接著是大小。

cues.en: We will actually specify a size, that's the color.
cues.zh: 我們會指定大小，這裡是顏色。

cues.en: We will also specify a color to distinguish our different clusters.
cues.zh: 也會指定顏色，區分不同的群組。

cues.en: And we will also specify, well, it is not here, but we'll specify a label because indeed, we would like to label each one of our clusters.
cues.zh: 還會指定標籤；雖然這裡沒有顯示，但我們想為每個群組加上標籤。

cues.en: Okay? Great, there we go.
cues.zh: 好嗎？很好，開始吧。

cues.en: So as we said, we're gonna use this scatter function to scatter plot each of the five clusters.
cues.zh: 剛才說了，要用 scatter 函式，分別畫出五個群組。

cues.en: So we're actually going to call five times this scatter function with different inputs.
cues.zh: 所以會使用不同輸入，呼叫 scatter 函式五次。

cues.en: And now we are starting with cluster number one, cluster of index zero.
cues.zh: 先從第一群，也就是索引為 0 的群組開始。

cues.en: So now the question is, according to you, how are we going to scatter plot all the customers who belong to cluster one to cluster of index zero?
cues.zh: 你覺得要怎麼把所有屬於第一群，也就是索引 0 群組的顧客畫出來？

cues.en: This customer, this customer, this one and this one and this one and this one, all the customers that have a zero here will be scatter plotted on this 3D chart,
cues.zh: 這位顧客、這位、這位、這位、這位，所有在這裡數值為 0 的顧客，都會畫在這張三維圖上，

cues.en: thanks to this first function we're calling.
cues.zh: 透過我們呼叫的第一個函式來完成。

cues.en: All right, well, let's just take it step by step.
cues.zh: 好，一步一步來。

cues.en: As we just saw, the first argument we have to input here are the x-coordinate of these customers who belong to cluster one.
cues.zh: 剛才看過，第一個要輸入的引數，是屬於第一群的這些顧客的 X 座標。

cues.en: All right, so well, naturally, the first thing we must do is start with X, right?
cues.zh: 很自然，首先必須從 X 開始，對吧？

cues.en: Because X contains exactly the different customers.
cues.zh: 因為 X 正好包含各位顧客。

cues.en: Remember X is actually the matrix of two columns containing the annual income in the first column and the spending score in the second column.
cues.zh: 記得 X 其實是兩欄的矩陣，第一欄是年收入，第二欄是消費分數。

cues.en: And each row of X responds to a different customer.
cues.zh: X 的每一列對應一位不同的顧客。

cues.en: And therefore, for each customer, the x-coordinate will be the annual income and the y-coordinate will be the spending score.
cues.zh: 因此，對每位顧客而言，X 座標是年收入，Y 座標是消費分數。

cues.en: So here, in order to get the x-coordinate, which is our first argument, well, we have to specify in a pair of square brackets.
cues.zh: 要取得第一個引數，也就是 X 座標，必須用一對方括號指定。

cues.en: And then after the comma, well, the index zero because that's the first index of the matrix X, therefore, the index of the first column,
cues.zh: 然後在逗號後面輸入索引 0，因為這是矩陣 X 的第一個索引，也就是第一欄的索引，

cues.en: the annual income, which is indeed the x-coordinate.
cues.zh: 代表年收入，正是 X 座標。

cues.en: But as you notice, I put this index of the column after the comma.
cues.zh: 不過你會注意到，我把欄索引放在逗號後面。

cues.en: And now, guess what must be before the comma and which corresponds of course to the rows we want to select in this cluster one.
cues.zh: 猜猜逗號前面要放什麼？當然就是指定第一群要選取哪些列。

cues.en: Well, there you go.
cues.zh: 來吧。

cues.en: I have a question for you.
cues.zh: 我有個問題。

cues.en: According to you, what are the rows of the matrix of features X that we want to select for this first cluster?
cues.zh: 你覺得第一個群組應該選取特徵矩陣 X 中的哪些列？

cues.en: Well, very simply, these rows have to be all the rows corresponding to the customers who belong to cluster one.
cues.zh: 很簡單，就是所有對應到第一群顧客的列。

cues.en: And how can we specify this here to the left of this comma to specify that we only want to select the rows of the customers who belong to cluster one?
cues.zh: 要怎麼在逗號左邊指定，只選取屬於第一群顧客的那些列？

cues.en: Well, the trick is to use our y-kmeans variable.
cues.zh: 技巧是使用 y_kmeans 變數。

cues.en: We're gonna call our y-kmeans variable and we're gonna specify here to the left of this comma to select the rows
cues.zh: 取用 y_kmeans 變數，在逗號左側指定要選取的列，

cues.en: where we're gonna specify y-kmeans, double equal, and zero so that it will select among these rows here, all the customers
cues.zh: 寫成 y_kmeans == 0，就會從這些列裡選出所有顧客，

cues.en: for which the y-kmeans variable equals zero.
cues.zh: 其 y_kmeans 變數等於 0。

cues.en: Therefore, that means it will select this customer, this customer, this customer, you see, all the ones for which y-kmeans is equal to zero.
cues.zh: 也就是會選取這位、這位、這位顧客；你看，所有 y_kmeans 等於 0 的人。

cues.en: And that's the trick in order to here indeed select all the rows corresponding to the customers that belong to cluster zero.
cues.zh: 這就是在這裡選出索引 0 群組所有顧客對應列的技巧。

cues.en: So these selects all these rows in this, select the first column, meaning the annual income, which indeed corresponds to the x-coordinate.
cues.zh: 這個條件選出那些列，這裡選出第一欄，也就是年收入，正好對應 X 座標。

cues.en: All right, so a bit tricky at first, but now it all makes sense.
cues.zh: 一開始有點繞，但現在就都合理了。

cues.en: We're just selecting the right rows and the right column and now we're gonna do the same for the y-coordinate and we're gonna do this efficiently.
cues.zh: 我們只是選取正確的列和欄。接著對 Y 座標做同樣的事，而且有效率地完成。

cues.en: So I'm copying this, and now, according to you, for the y-coordinate, what do we need to replace here?
cues.zh: 我把這裡複製過來。你覺得 Y 座標這裡要改什麼？

cues.en: Well, for the rows, well, that's exactly the same.
cues.zh: 列的部分完全相同。

cues.en: We still want the same rows corresponding to the customers for which y-kmeans is equal to zero meaning the customers of cluster zero, but for the column, we of course
cues.zh: 仍然要選取 y_kmeans 等於 0 的顧客所對應的列，也就是索引 0 群組的顧客；但欄的部分，當然

cues.en: want to select the index one which corresponds to the spending score, right?
cues.zh: 要選取索引 1，對應消費分數，對吧？

cues.en: X has two columns, the column of index zero, which is the annual income and the column of index one, which is the spending score.
cues.zh: X 有兩欄，索引 0 是年收入，索引 1 是消費分數。

cues.en: And that's exactly how we select here all the y-coordinates of the customers that belong to cluster one, cluster of index zero.
cues.zh: 這就是選取第一群，也就是索引 0 群組所有顧客 Y 座標的方法。

cues.en: All right? All right.
cues.zh: 好嗎？好。

cues.en: So that was a trick.
cues.zh: 這就是剛才的技巧。

cues.en: And now let's add the simple stuff.
cues.zh: 接著加上簡單的部分。

cues.en: So that was the size, S equals.
cues.zh: 先是大小，s 等於。

cues.en: And we're gonna choose a size of 100 here, which will just display some big enough points so that we can see them.
cues.zh: 這裡選擇大小 100，讓顯示的點夠大，看得清楚。

cues.en: And each of these points will be, of course, the different customers of cluster zero, okay?
cues.zh: 每個點當然代表索引 0 群組中的不同顧客，好嗎？

cues.en: And then, as we said, we want to add a color for which the parameter's name is C.
cues.zh: 接著如同剛才所說，要加上顏色，參數名稱是 c。

cues.en: And well, let's just choose our first cluster to have the color red.
cues.zh: 就把第一個群組設為紅色。

cues.en: And then as we said, we also want to add a label.
cues.zh: 然後還要加上標籤。

cues.en: And this cluster, we will call it cluster one.
cues.zh: 把這個群組命名為 Cluster 1。
